facts.fact: Think Tank Law and Technologies said on 6 August 2024 that the data protection authority created by article 262 of the digital code is not yet operational and needs a decree fixing its organisation.
facts.system: Data protection authority, article 262 of the digital code

facts.fact: Think Tank Law and Technologies' study of the legal framework for personal data protection in the DRC, presented on 6 August 2024, treats the digital code as the law in force.
Think Tank Law and Technologies' study, presented 6 August 2024, treats the digital code's personal data rules as the law in force.
Think Tank Law and Technologies said on 6 August 2024 that the authority created by article 262 of the digital code still has to be made operational by decree.
Think Tank Law and Technologies, a Kinshasa study bureau, published its first study on the legal framework for personal data protection in the DRC on 6 August 2024.

COD.note: Document says Malabo ratification must still be finalised by depositing instruments; no signature or ratification date is stated.
